value.notes: Turn 1: starting exploration. Plan: check basic step, dash recharge display, pause/resume, and HUD vs state. No findings yet.

Turn 2: invalid token 'resume' was the error last turn. Valid tokens: up/down/left/right, dash-*, use, pause, esc, enter, wait, click:<id>, a+b, goto:x,y. Now testing basic movement, dash recharge display, and pause/resume with a few ticks.

Run 1 showed time 297->295 across pause/wait/esc/wait, suspicious: paused ticks may decrement timer. Testing pause-only sequence: expect time stays 300 while paused, 299 after esc resume + wait. Then check dialog/pause-menu state and whether pause tick itself counts.

Confirmed one bug: a dash passes through a wall. From (1,1), 'right' moves to (2,1); then 'dash-down' should stop before the wall at (2,2) and leave the player at (2,1). Instead it goes to (2,3), crossing the wall. Run 2 reproduces it on seed 1 with 2 tokens. Neither 'right' nor 'dash-down' alone reproduces it, so 2 tokens is minimal.

Pause/timer checks (runs 1 and 3) looked correct. The timer stays at 300 while paused, and the esc tick that resumes the game also counts down by 1. Under section 2, the resuming tick is a running tick, so I did not report it.

Not explored: enemy collisions, spikes, gates and levers, the dialogs, and the score/lives limits. The USD budget was nearly exhausted, so I stopped here.

reports.title: Dash passes through a wall tile
reports.observed: From (1,1), 'right' then 'dash-down' ends at (2,3). The dash crossed the wall at (2,2).
reports.expected: The dash stops before the first solid tile. The wall at (2,2) blocks it, so the player stays at (2,1) and the dash is not used up (section 3).
